## What to use

### From Google

- **[Google Sheets (gws-sheets)](../../skills/gws-sheets/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records without asking first · needs resource and method · [source](https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/tree/main/skills/gws-sheets)

- **[Google Sheets append (gws-sheets-append)](../../skills/gws-sheets-append/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs --spreadsheet · [source](https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/tree/main/skills/gws-sheets-append)

- **[gws-sheets-read](../../skills/gws-sheets-read/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs --spreadsheet · [source](https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/tree/main/skills/gws-sheets-read)
  Google Sheets: Read values from a spreadsheet.
